items.title: Base change for a pushforward of a sheaf of sets along a flat morphism with geometrically connected strict henselisations
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes base change for pushforwards of sheaves of sets along a flat morphism whose strict henselisations have geometrically connected fibres (statement lines 16784-16804). The proof (proof lines 16806-16831) reduces to the comparison of geometric stalks, writes both as sections over fibre products by the higher-direct-images theorem, and identifies them by sections upstairs applied to the base change of the strict henselisations. H2: one stalk computation with one application of sections upstairs.
